mapper.insert: INSERT INTO danmakus (video_id, manuscript_id, user_id, content, time, color, mode, created_at) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{manuscriptId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{time}, #{color}, #{mode}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM danmakus WHERE video_id = #{videoId} ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT * FROM danmakus WHERE manuscript_id = #{manuscriptId} ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT * FROM danmakus WHERE video_id = #{videoId} AND manuscript_id = #{manuscriptId} ORDER BY time ASC
